about: Synthetic scenario for the Incident Messenger prototype (P3). One day, two scenarios, all times UTC. This file plays the role of the knowledge base: the only facts the agent may send are the versions approved by the incident commander (IC) below. No real company, customer or incident.

facts.text: Since 09:38 UTC, metrics ingestion in our EU region is degraded. Dashboards of EU accounts may show missing or delayed data. Our engineers are working on it. Next update by 10:30 UTC.
Since 10:20 UTC, metrics ingestion in our EU region is recovering. Dashboards may still show delayed data. Next update by 11:00 UTC.

incidents.trigger: alert notification queue delay above 5 minutes in us-east

facts.text: Since 09:50 UTC, alert notifications for US accounts are delayed by up to 15 minutes. Metrics ingestion and dashboards are not affected. Next update by 10:45 UTC.

incidents.trigger: log query p95 latency above 30 s in us-east

facts.text: Since 18:05 UTC, log search for US accounts is degraded: queries may time out or return partial results. Logs are still being collected; ingestion is not affected. Next update by 19:00 UTC.
Since 18:50 UTC, log search for US accounts is recovering. Some queries may still be slow. Next update by 19:30 UTC.

Since 18:35 UTC, some requests to the Telemetra API in our EU and US regions are rejected with HTTP 429 (too many requests) errors. Dashboards, alerting and data collection are not affected. Next update by 19:30 UTC.
